title: Software Engineer
description: Itron is innovating new ways for utilities and cities to manage energy and water. We create a more resourceful world to protect essential resources for today and tomorrow. Join us. Itron Resiliency Solutions is an innovative business unit within Itron focused on solving mission critical problems for utilities through software and AI. Resiliency Solutions offers unique, market leading solutions for front-line worker safety, storm response, excavation damage prevention, construction management, and many more. These software and AI solutions solve end-to-end challenges for the utilities that power our society and are used by the largest and most complex organizations in the world such as National Grid, Southern Company, and Exelon. Itron Resiliency Solutions is a global, diverse team of builders and innovators who tackle previously impossible challenges for our customers. If you have a desire to challenge yourself, solve impactful problems, and work with a passionate and talented team, this is the place. The Emergency Preparedness & Response (EP&R) team builds the systems that keep critical operations running when it matters most. When storms and severe weather threaten communities and infrastructure across the US, our platform enables customers to rapidly procure, mobilize, and manage the workforce needed to respond to and recover from storm damage — often under tight timelines and high-stakes conditions. We are looking for a Principal Engineer who is deeply hands-on, works backward from customer pain points and business needs, and measures success by impact rather than lines of code shipped. You will be the technical anchor of the team: a backend-heavy full-stack engineer who knows our systems inside and out, reasons rigorously about trade-offs, and raises the engineering bar for everyone around you while leading the team toward outcomes that genuinely matter. About the role We're hiring a Software Engineer in Bengaluru to build and run production services. You'll own features end to end — from understanding the problem to shipping, monitoring and fixing what you built — with growing independence and support from senior engineers. Our India engineering team is taking full ownership of core products and growing quickly, including a ground-up rebuild of a customer-critical service. You'll work closely with senior engineers, your Engineering Manager, Product and Customer Support. What you'll own in your first year Own: Own features and services end to end with speed and quality — build, test, release, monitor, fix. Well-scoped problems, then bigger ones. Start with clearly defined work and grow into breaking down ambiguous problems yourself. Design. Write design notes for your features and get them reviewed; contribute to larger designs led by senior engineers. Quality. Write tests, add observability, and take part in on-call so issues are caught before customers see them. Customers. Understand who uses what you build, and learn from support issues what to fix next. Code reviews. Give and receive thoughtful reviews, and help onboard engineers who join after you. What you must bring These are the bar. We can't teach them on the job. Experience: 1–4 years building production software. We level on demonstrated scope, not years alone. You've shipped code that runs in production. Features or services you built, released and supported — not only coursework or prototypes. You are strong at problem solving. You can take an unfamiliar, feature-sized problem, reason through it, and land on a simple, correct solution. You work independently toward a clear goal. Given a clear goal, you figure out the steps, unblock yourself, and ask for help at the right moments. We care how you engineer more than which language you did it in. Technical background You've built production software with a modern stack, such as: Cloud: hands-on with AWS — you've deployed and debugged services running on it. Languages: strong in at least one modern language such as Python, Java or JavaScript/TypeScript. Frameworks: modern service frameworks such as FastAPI, Node.js or equivalents. Databases: solid data modeling and query fundamentals — you can design a schema, use indexes well, and explain why a query is slow and how you'd fix it. Fundamentals: data structures, API design, and the basics of caching and concurrency. Exact tools matter less than depth. Strong experience on an equivalent stack is welcome. What sets great candidates apart Impact you can explain. You can say what changed because of something you built — for users, performance or reliability. One problem you went deep on. A bug, a performance issue or a design where you dug past the surface to understand why. Ownership beyond the ticket. You've fixed what you shipped when it broke, and improved it after release without being asked. Framework mindset: You notice repeated code and turn it into something reusable. Learning speed. You've picked up a new domain, codebase or technology quickly and delivered in it. Curiosity about the user. You've asked why a requirement exists, or suggested a simpler way to solve the user's problem. What we look for in everyone we hire Whatever the role, we hire for six things. Customer obsession. You care who uses what you build and whether it actually helped them. Impact over activity. You measure success by outcomes, not tickets closed or lines written. Honesty. You're specific about your own part in team work, raise problems early, and say what didn't work. Independence. You don't wait to be told every next step. You figure things out with little hand-holding. You will work with leaders who will partner with you in the journey. Passion. Not the word on a resume — the evidence: a side project, a technology you went deep on, something you built because you wanted to. Depth. At least one thing you've built or debugged that you can explain down to the internals and the tradeoffs. Itron is committed to building an inclusive and diverse workforce and providing an authentic workplace experience for all employees. If you are excited about this role but your past experiences don't perfectly align with every requirement, we encourage you to apply anyway. In the end, you may be just who we are looking for! The successful candidate's starting wage will be determined based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as skills and experience. Itron is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. If you require an accommodation to apply, please contact a recruiting representative at 1-800-635-5461 or email Accessibility@itron.com. Itron is transforming how the world manages energy, water and city services. Our trusted intelligent infrastructure solutions help utilities and cities improve efficiency, build resilience and deliver safe, reliable and affordable service. With edge intelligence, we connect people, data insights and devices so communities can better manage the essential resources they rely on to live. Join us as we create a more resourceful world: www.itron.com

title: Data Scientist (3-5 years)
description: Data Scientist, real estate ontology MRI Software is hiring Data Scientists to turn a real estate ontology into products: the models, agents and analytics that only become possible when every property, lease, tenant, asset and transaction is described in one shared, machine-readable language. About the role MRI is building a Common Data Model that unifies data across its product portfolio. On top of it we are creating a real estate ontology: the entities, relationships, rules and semantics of the industry. You will be among the first data scientists to work on that foundation. Your job is to discover what can be built on it, prove it with working models and prototypes, and hand the winners to product teams. This is a research-to-product role. Expect to spend as much time finding the right problem as solving it. What you will do Help turn the Common Data Model into a real estate ontology: entities, relationships, constraints and business rules across leasing, property operations, assets, investments, and facilities. Explore the ontology with data to find high-value solutions: forecasting, anomaly detection, entity resolution, Decision modeling / recommendation, valuation signals, and portfolio optimization. Build and validate models on real product data from across the MRI portfolio, with clear baselines and honest evaluation. Prototype ontology-grounded AI: knowledge-graph retrieval, LLM agents that reason over typed entities, and natural-language analytics with a semantic layer. Define metrics and a semantic layer so that a number means the same thing in every product. Partner with product, engineering and domain experts to move proven prototypes into the MRI platform. Raise the bar on data quality: find mapping gaps, bad joins and silent failures, and feed them back into the model. What you bring Required Bachelor's or master's or PhD (from Premier Institute) in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Data Science, Physics or a related quantitative field 3-5 years of applied data science experience Strong foundations in statistics, probability, optimization and machine learning, and the judgment to know when a simple model is enough. Fluent Python and SQL; comfort with modern data stacks (Spark, a cloud warehouse such as Snowflake or Databricks, dbt or similar). Hands-on experience with at least one of: knowledge graphs, ontologies or semantic modelling, entity resolution, or LLM-based applications (retrieval, agents, evaluation). Strong verbal and written communication skills Strong plus Experience in real estate, proptech, finance, or any other asset-heavy domains. (preferred not mandatory) Published research, patents, competition results, or open-source work. Experience taking a model from notebook to production with MLOps practices. description: To make electronics, you need chips, wafers, transistors, reticles, and... To make these, you must see, test and manufacture them at scale—faster and better than ever before. That's where KLA comes in. Whether you're early in your career or an experienced professional, you'll solve complex challenges, work alongside brilliant minds and help shape the future of technology. Group/Division The Semiconductor Products and Customers (Semi PC) business unit designs, builds and sells KLA’s product portfolio to help chip manufacturers meet high-quality standards for technologies like AI, data centers, automotive and electronic devices. Our inspection, metrology, and analytics systems detect and monitor defects across logic and memory chips, specialty semiconductors, wafers, reticles, advanced packaging, process equipment and materials. We also develop technologies for specialty processes, IC substrates, and PCB manufacturing, including etch and deposition, component inspection, and imaging and analytics. The LS-SWIFT division delivers high-throughput patterned wafer inspection systems that support advanced semiconductor manufacturing. Its mission is to provide industry-leading defect detection with optimal cost of ownership across a wide range of applications. LS systems enable precise, cost-effective inspection for cutting-edge process nodes, while SWIFT systems offer comprehensive macro inspection of all wafer surfaces—capabilities that are especially critical for advanced packaging, as well as logic, memory, and automotive applications. What You'll Do In this role, you will play a key part in advancing business priorities by delivering high-impact work across your area of expertise. Company Overview KLA is a global leader in diversified electronics for the semiconductor manufacturing ecosystem. Virtually every electronic device in the world is produced using our technologies. No laptop, smartphone, wearable device, voice-controlled gadget, flexible screen, VR device or smart car would have made it into your hands without us. KLA invents systems and solutions for the manufacturing of wafers and reticles, integrated circuits, packaging, printed circuit boards and flat panel displays. The innovative ideas and devices that are advancing humanity all begin with inspiration, research and development. KLA focuses more than average on innovation and we invest 15% of sales back into R&D. Our expert teams of physicists, engineers, data scientists and problem-solvers work together with the world’s leading technology providers to accelerate the delivery of tomorrow’s electronic devices. Life here is exciting and our teams thrive on tackling really hard problems. There is never a dull moment with us. Group/Division With over 40 years of semiconductor process control experience, chipmakers around the globe rely on KLA to ensure that their fabs ramp next-generation devices to volume production quickly and cost-effectively. Enabling the movement towards advanced chip design, KLA's Global Products Group (GPG), which is responsible for creating all of KLA’s metrology and inspection products, is looking for the best and the brightest research scientist, software engineers, application development engineers, and senior product technology process engineers. The LS-SWIFT Division of KLA’s Global Products Group provides patterned wafer inspection systems for high-volume semiconductor manufacturing. Its mission is to deliver market-leading cost of ownership in defect detection for a broad range of applications in the production of semiconductors. Customers from the foundry, logic, memory, automotive, MEMS, advanced packaging and other markets rely upon high-sample wafer inspection information generated by LS-SWIFT products. LS (Laser Scanning) systems enable cost-effective patterned wafer defect detection for the industry’s most sophisticated process technologies deployed in leading-edge foundry, logic, DRAM, and NAND fabs. SWIFT (Simultaneous Wafer Inspection at Fast Throughput) systems deliver all-wafer-surface (frontside, backside, and edge) macro inspection that is critical for automotive IC, MEMS, and advanced packaging processes as well as foundry/logic and memory fabs. LS-SWIFT operates from a global footprint that includes the US, Singapore, India and Germany, and serves a worldwide customer base across Asia, Europe and North America. Design skills is a plus. From electron and photon optics to machine learning and data analytics, we seek perfection at the most fundamental level of matter in the universe. If you want to make electronics that push industries forward and make the world a better place, join us. To ensure a fair and consistent evaluation, the use of AI, recording tools or other technologies to generate, suggest or provide responses during interviews—whether virtual or in person—is not permitted unless explicitly approved in advance as part of a reasonable accommodation or invited by the interviewer. KLA is committed to advancing innovation through responsible AI, and we value candidates who share this mindset. We offer a competitive, family friendly total rewards package.
